panels.title: Attendance rate
panels.description: Sessions attended out of sessions expected, with the rules picked at the top.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)

panels.title: Change
panels.description: Attendance rate compared with the same length of time just before the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH now_ AS (SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) AS r FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)),
     before AS (SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) AS r FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND starts_at < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND starts_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))
SELECT CASE WHEN before.r IS NULL OR now_.r IS NULL THEN 'No earlier data'
            WHEN now_.r = before.r THEN 'No change'
            ELSE to_char(now_.r - before.r, 'SG990.0') || ' points' END AS "Change"
FROM now_, before

panels.title: Sessions held
panels.description: Finished sessions; cancelled ones are not counted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)
SELECT count(DISTINCT student_id) FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)

panels.title: Below target
panels.description: Students below the target in at least one class (listed further down).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at) GROUP BY student_id, section_id HAVING count(*) >= CAST(NULLIF('$min_sessions', '') AS integer) AND round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) < CAST(NULLIF('$target', '') AS numeric)) s

panels.title: Requests waiting
panels.description: Requests not yet approved or rejected, whatever their date.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM reporting.absence_requests WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND status = 'pending'

panels.title: Attendance over time
panels.description: Use 'Trend by' and 'Trend lines' at the top to group by week or month, or split by class. The dashed line is the target.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN '$bucket' = 'session' THEN starts_at ELSE date_trunc('$bucket', starts_at) END AS time,
       CASE '$split' WHEN 'class' THEN section_name WHEN 'professor' THEN professor_name
            ELSE 'Attendance rate' END AS metric,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) AS value
FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, CAST(NULLIF('$target', '') AS numeric) AS "Target"
UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz, CAST(NULLIF('$target', '') AS numeric)

panels.title: By day of the week
panels.description: Attendance rate on each weekday that had sessions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trim(to_char(session_date, 'Day')) AS "Day", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) AS "Attendance rate"
FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)
GROUP BY 1, extract(isodow FROM session_date) ORDER BY extract(isodow FROM session_date)

panels.title: Attendance by class
panels.description: Click a bar to open that class's report.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT section_id, section_name AS "Class", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) AS "Attendance rate"
FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)
GROUP BY section_id, section_name ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: What happened at each class
panels.description: Share of expected check-ins that were on time, late, excused or missed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT section_name AS "Class",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'present') / count(*), 1) AS "Present",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'late') / count(*), 1) AS "Late",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'excused') / count(*), 1) AS "Excused",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'absent') / count(*), 1) AS "Absent"
FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)
GROUP BY section_name ORDER BY section_name

panels.title: Students below target
panels.description: Students under the target attendance in a class. Click a name for their full history.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT student_id, section_id,
       student_name AS "Student", student_email AS "Email", section_name AS "Class",
       count(*) AS "Sessions",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'absent') AS "Absent",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'late') AS "Late",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'excused') AS "Excused",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) AS "Attendance",
       CASE WHEN count(*) < CAST(NULLIF('$min_sessions', '') AS integer) THEN 'Too early to tell' WHEN round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) < CAST(NULLIF('$target', '') AS numeric) THEN 'Below target' WHEN round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) < CAST(NULLIF('$target', '') AS numeric) + 5 THEN 'Close to target' ELSE 'On track' END AS "Standing",
       max(starts_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('present', 'late')) AS "Last seen"
FROM reporting.student_session_status
WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)
GROUP BY student_id, student_name, student_email, section_id, section_name
HAVING count(*) >= CAST(NULLIF('$min_sessions', '') AS integer) AND round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) < CAST(NULLIF('$target', '') AS numeric)
ORDER BY "Attendance", "Absent" DESC, "Student"

panels.title: All students
panels.description: Every student per class. Use the column filters to narrow the list.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT student_id, section_id,
       student_name AS "Student", student_email AS "Email", section_name AS "Class",
       count(*) AS "Sessions",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'absent') AS "Absent",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'late') AS "Late",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'excused') AS "Excused",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) AS "Attendance",
       CASE WHEN count(*) < CAST(NULLIF('$min_sessions', '') AS integer) THEN 'Too early to tell' WHEN round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) < CAST(NULLIF('$target', '') AS numeric) THEN 'Below target' WHEN round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) < CAST(NULLIF('$target', '') AS numeric) + 5 THEN 'Close to target' ELSE 'On track' END AS "Standing",
       max(starts_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('present', 'late')) AS "Last seen"
FROM reporting.student_session_status
WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)
GROUP BY student_id, student_name, student_email, section_id, section_name

ORDER BY "Attendance", "Absent" DESC, "Student"

SELECT section_id, starts_at AS "Session", section_name AS "Class",
       count(*) AS "Expected",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'present') AS "Present",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'late') AS "Late",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'excused') AS "Excused",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'absent') AS "Absent",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present' OR (status = 'late' AND '$late' = 'yes'))) / NULLIF(count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'excused' AND '$excused' = 'skip')), 0), 1) AS "Attendance"
FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at)
GROUP BY session_id, section_id, section_name, starts_at
ORDER BY starts_at DESC

SELECT CASE confirmation_method WHEN 'code' THEN 'Typed the code' WHEN 'qr' THEN 'Scanned the QR code'
            WHEN 'manual' THEN 'Marked by the professor' WHEN 'scan' THEN 'Attendance sheet photo'
            WHEN 'absence_request' THEN 'Approved absence request' ELSE coalesce(confirmation_method, 'Other') END
       AS "Method",
       count(*) AS "Check-ins"
FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at) AND confirmation_method IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: When students checked in
panels.description: Minutes between the start of the session and the check-in.

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN minutes_after_start < 5 THEN 1 WHEN minutes_after_start < 10 THEN 2
              WHEN minutes_after_start < 15 THEN 3 WHEN minutes_after_start < 20 THEN 4
              WHEN minutes_after_start < 30 THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS k
  FROM reporting.student_session_status WHERE section_id IN ($section) AND $__timeFilter(starts_at) AND status IN ('present', 'late') AND minutes_after_start IS NOT NULL)
SELECT (ARRAY['0–5 min', '5–10 min', '10–15 min', '15–20 min', '20–30 min', '30+ min'])[k] AS "Minutes after start",
       count(*) AS "Check-ins"
FROM b GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

options.content:
**What counts.** A session counts once it has ended; cancelled sessions never count. A student is expected at a
session if they were in the class when it started, or if they checked in there as a visitor from another group.

**Attendance rate** = sessions attended ÷ sessions expected. The settings at the top change the rule:

- *Late arrivals*: count a late check-in as attended (default) or as missed.
- *Excused absences*: leave them out of the rate (default, like the app) or count them as missed.
- *Target attendance*: students below it are marked **Below target**, within 5 points **Close to target**.
- *Flag after*: students with fewer sessions are shown as **Too early to tell**.

**Getting around.** Click a class name to open its class report, or a student name for the student report.
Your settings and time range come along. The links at the top right switch between the three reports.

**Your own version.** Change any panel, then use *Save as* to keep a personal copy. The original stays as is.
